summary: Tested Smart Announcements AI feature using Gemini 3 Flash. Backend AI generation fully working (11/12 tests passed). Frontend UI flows working correctly: AI Generate button, dialog with topic/tone/audience, generation, Regenerate, and Use This button. CRITICAL BUG: AI badge not showing on published AI announcements because is_ai_generated flag is not passed from frontend to backend.

minor.issue: Backend hardcodes is_ai_generated: False - should accept is_ai_generated from request body when passed

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: AI badge not showing on published AI announcements. When 'Use This' transfers AI content to form, is_ai_generated flag is not included in formData. Published announcements don't have AI badge.
ui_bugs.fix_details: In handleUseGenerated(), set formData.is_ai_generated = true. In handleSubmit(), pass is_ai_generated to api.createAnnouncement(). Backend /api/announcements endpoint needs to accept is_ai_generated field.

issues: Console warning: In HTML, <tr> cannot be a child of <span> - hydration error. React component wrapping issue in DashboardPage.

Backend: POST /api/announcements - creates announcement with AI-generated content
Backend: GET /api/announcements - returns list with is_ai_generated field
Backend: POST /api/announcements/generate - requires authentication (401 without token)
Backend: POST /api/announcements - requires authentication (401 without token)
Frontend: AI Generate button opens AI Announcement Generator dialog
Frontend: Dialog has topic, tone dropdown, target audience fields
Frontend: Tone dropdown has Professional, Friendly, Urgent, Celebratory options
Frontend: Generate button triggers AI generation with loading state
Frontend: AI result shows title and content in styled container
Frontend: Regenerate button clears result and returns to form with topic preserved
Frontend: Use This button transfers AI title and content to Create Announcement form
Frontend: Publish button creates announcement and shows success toast
action_items: FIX BUG: AI badge not showing on published AI announcements
1. In AnnouncementsPage.jsx handleUseGenerated(): Add is_ai_generated: true to formData when using AI content
2. Update formData state to include is_ai_generated field (default false for manual, true when from AI)
3. Modify handleSubmit() to pass is_ai_generated flag to createAnnouncement API
4. Update backend POST /api/announcements to accept and use is_ai_generated from request body instead of hardcoding False
Minor: Fix React hydration warning in DashboardPage - <tr> cannot be child of <span>
critical_code_review_comments: AnnouncementsPage.jsx line 93-103: handleUseGenerated() does not include is_ai_generated from aiResult, causing AI badge to never appear
server.py line 821: is_ai_generated is hardcoded to False in createAnnouncement - should accept from request body

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 tests passed, 1 skipped for missing employee credentials)
success_rate.frontend: 90% (All UI flows work, but AI badge feature broken)

rca_of_the_issue.bug: AI badge not showing on published AI-generated announcements
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: 1. Frontend handleUseGenerated() at line 93-103 only copies title, content, priority from aiResult - does NOT copy is_ai_generated flag. 2. Backend createAnnouncement() at line 821 hardcodes is_ai_generated: False instead of accepting from request body.
reproduction_steps: 7. Observe: Announcement appears WITHOUT AI badge
rca_of_the_issue.expected_behavior: Published announcements created from AI-generated content should display the AI badge (sparkles icon with 'AI' text)
rca_of_the_issue.actual_behavior: No AI badge shown because is_ai_generated is always False in database
mitigation_steps: Update formData state to include is_ai_generated
In handleUseGenerated(), set is_ai_generated: true when using AI content
Pass is_ai_generated to createAnnouncement API call
Update backend AnnouncementCreate model to include is_ai_generated field
Use request body is_ai_generated value in backend instead of hardcoding False
